definitions.full: H2460. Cheleb II. חֵ֫לֶב proper name, masculine (Sabean proper name, masculine חֿלבן = the crafty one SabDenkm 27. 28 ) — one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:29 (but read חלד(יׅ , see Dr), ᵐ5 Εσθαει , A Αλαφ , ᵐ5 L Αλλαν (= חֵלֶד 1Chr 11:30 = חֶלְדַּי 27:15 ).
